summary.text: Greg Elkins is a Republican state senator who has represented District 28 since June 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Greg Elkins was born in Kentucky and served in the Kentucky National Guard.
His career experience includes working as CEO of a waste management company, and he has served as a Clark County magistrate.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the State and Local Government Committee and serves on the Senate Banking and Insurance, Natural Resources and Energy, and Transportation committees.
